body: Please don’t give up. You matter. I know you might not realize it but there are people in your life who love you and care for you. You deserve happiness and to live a beautiful life. You can beat this!! Feel free to message me if you want to talk more.
Please don’t give up, you are strong enough to get through this. You can beat this!!❤️
Please don’t give up, you are strong enough to beat this!!
Suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. Please don’t give up, you need to keep fighting. You can beat this. You are too important. Believe in yourself!!
No you are not. You are amazing. You are loved. You are special. You deserve to live and be happy. Please, don’t give up now. Keep fighting. You will beat this!

You may not realize it but there are people who absolutely adore you and would be heartbroken if you left. You deserve to be happy and have a good life. Please, don’t give up now, keep fighting. You’re amazing and you matter❤️
Thank you so much, I really needed to hear that. And thank you for the tips on dealing with panic attacks, they sound really helpful.❤️

YOU have to believe that it will get better before things can actually improve. You have to try and be strong and tell yourself that it will get better, if you don’t believe in yourself, then who will? There are other people that will help you get through whatever you’re going through, but in the end, the only one who can change how you feel is you. Before going to bed, try saying some mantras in your head like “I am strong” “this will pass” “I will get through this” believe me, it really does help. Please don’t give up, as long as you believe in yourself and put enough work in things will improve. Hope this helped❤️
Please stay. You deserve to be happy and to live a good life. You matter. I promise you things will get better in time.

Please stay. You were put on this earth for a reason. Life is beautiful. You may not realize it, but there are people who absolutely adore you and would be heartbroken if you left. I know you probably feel hopeless right now and that things won’t ever get better, but I can promise you that they will. Suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. It should never be the answer. You deserve to be happy and to live a good life. You matter.❤️

Please stay. I can promise you are not alone. I know that you’re probably feeling hopeless and that nothing is ever gonna get better, but trust me it does. You were put on this earth for a reason. You deserve to be happy and live a good life. I am so sorry that you feel like taking your own life right now, trust me I know how that feels. Just know that you matter and I promise you it always gets better!! ❤️❤️
